blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Letran turned to Denzil Walker in the squad’s convincing 83-72 win over the College of St. Benilde in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. Walker stuffed the stat sheet with 21 points, seven rebounds, four assists and two steals to pace the Knights to the win. “I just felt like tonight, we were everywhere on defense so we really had no problems,” he said. “We capitalized on defense. After the turnovers, we just made them pay for it.” Letran started hot with a 24-13 lead at the end of the first quarter, with […]...
